basic_info.description:
Exceptional investment opportunity in the heart of San Franciscos desirable Central Sunset District. 1800 20th Avenue is a  6-unit apartment building featuring six spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bath units. Each unit includes a designated parking space, a rare amenity in the city, along with access to on-site laundry facilities.
All units are currently occupied, offering immediate rental income and long-term stability. Ideally located near public transportation, shopping, dining, schools, and parks, this property appeals to renters and investors alike.
